newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets see selective spot buying.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets see selective spot buying.

text.p: Europe's cotton markets saw selective, small volume business on Thursday, market sources reported.
Sellers in Portugal, Italy and France found occasional buyers of Central Asian and West African medium-better qualities for early summer delivery.
There was some limited enquiry for Central Asian origins in Germany but no firm trades reported.
Poland saw hand-to-mouth purchasing but elsewhere Eastern European markets remained neglected.
Turnover in long staple varieties was reported slow although at least one retail buyer contracted for a delivery of American Pima cotton.
